name: @copilotkit/showcase-frontend-nextjs
//zod: `zod` is v4 because it is FORCED, not chosen: @tanstack/ai-openai@0.15.6 hard-requires peer zod@^4,
and built-in-agent's in-process agent routes need @tanstack/ai. v4 is also safe with ZERO demo edits:
built-in-agent already pins zod@^4.4.0 and runs the demo sources byte-identically to the v3-pinned
vs langgraph-python), green in production. The demo code is written in a both-majors subset.
Demo folders are copied VERBATIM by the starter CLI, which may not edit source — so never rewrite a
demo's zod import when porting it here.
The `zod4` alias is NOT used by anything in this app today: a grep for `zod4` across
frontends/nextjs (excluding node_modules and the .next build cache) matches only this
package.json and package-lock.json — no source file imports it. This app's single copy of the demo,
It stays purely for the starter CLI's copy-verbatim guarantee. These two integration files
DO import the literal `zod4` specifier and are not ported here yet:
Because the CLI may not edit copied demo source, porting either folder would land a `zod4`
import here unchanged, and the alias is what keeps that resolvable. Delete it only together
with the lockfile entry, and only once those demos are confirmed ported or dropped.
//scripts: No `test:e2e`. Every integration has one (`playwright test`) because every
integration ships a playwright.config.ts and a tests/e2e/ directory — the
showcase_validate.yml e2e-spec-count baseline enforces exactly that. This app
has NEITHER, so the script could only ever fail (`playwright test` exits with
"no configuration file found"). Re-add it together with a playwright.config.ts
and real specs, not before. The now-orphaned `@playwright/test` devDependency
is STILL DECLARED below: dropping it also requires regenerating
package-lock.json (npm ci hard-fails when the two disagree), which is a
separate change. Remove the two together.
`lint` (`next lint`) IS kept even though it is dead here — no eslint,
no eslint-config-next, no config file, and `next lint` is deprecated in
Next 15.5. It is dead in exactly the same way in all 20 integrations
(integrations/mastra declares the identical script with no eslint dep and no
config either), so this is fleet-wide debt, not an artifact of this app.
Fix it fleet-wide or not at all; diverging here would just hide it.
`typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) is NOT clean: it reports 49 errors on a clean tree,
inherited from demo folders and built-in-agent factories copied byte-identically
from integrations that pin different upstream SDK versions. next.config.ts sets
`ignoreBuildErrors: true` so `next build` ignores all of them. The only thing that
runs this script in CI is the `frontend-nextjs-unit-tests` job in
.github/workflows/showcase_validate.yml, and it gates on the error COUNT not rising
above the `TSC_ERROR_BASELINE` pinned there. If you change the count, update that
baseline in the same commit. Do not rename this script to `check-types` hoping
static_quality.yml will pick it up — this app has no project.json and is not a
pnpm-workspace member, so `nx run-many` cannot select it either way.
